known_information: Issue: ### Microsoft PowerToys version 0.62.1 ### Running as admin - [ ] Yes ### Area(s) with issue? General ### Steps to reproduce Install PowerToys open Terminal and run "winget list" ### ✔️ Expected Behavior Only PowerToys is show in the list like this: PowerToys (Preview) x64 | Microsoft.PowerToys | 0.62.1 | winget ### ❌ Actual Behavior Two extra applications are shown: PowerRenameContextMenu | PowerRenameContextMenu_8wekyb3d8bbwe | 1.0.0.0 Microsoft.PowerToys.ImageResizerContextMenu | Microsoft.PowerToys.ImageResizerContextMenu_8wekyb3d8bbwe | 1.0.0.0 ### Other Software Windows Package Manager Source (winget) | Microsoft.Winget.Source_8wekyb3d8bbwe | 2022.923.2026.688

Comment by htcfreek: @stefansjfw , @yuyoyuppe Wondering about the name of PowerRemameContextMenu package as `Microsoft.PowerToys` is missing at the beginning. And is it expected that the package version is 1.0.0.0 istead of the PT version?

Comment by JulianTompa: > @stefansjfw , @yuyoyuppe Wondering about the name of PowerRemameContextMenu package as `Microsoft.PowerToys` is missing at the beginning. And is it expected that the package version is 1.0.0.0 istead of the PT version? Here is an image that better shows the problem ![Winget](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/86064414/192105837-6320adb0-e6ef-411c-ad8e-5a831b3afb5f.png) (I have removed all the rows from winget that are not relevant to this issue)

Comment by stefansjfw: > is it expected that the package version is 1.0.0.0 istead of the PT this is being fixed by https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/pull/20881 @JulianTompa Regarding 2 extra applications... This is how tier 1 context menu items work in Win11. In order to show PowerRename and ImageResizer in Win11 tier 1 context menu, packages need to be registered and those registered packages are shown by winget list.

Comment by htcfreek: > > is it expected that the package version is 1.0.0.0 istead of the PT > > this is being fixed by https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/pull/20881 Perfect. 👍 > @JulianTompa Regarding 2 extra applications... In order to show PowerRename and ImageResizer in Win11 tier 1 context menu, packages need to be registered and those registered packages are shown by winget list. Can't winget group them together? They are all belongs to PT and I expected that they are depend on it.

Comment by stefansjfw: > They are all belongs to PT and I expected that they are depend on it. Not really. Those are being registered during runtime, only if OS is Win11, so not really regular package dependency
